title: Inside LA's Fall Friday Nights at MacArthur Park
description:
Fall Friday Nights brought free family fun, community resources, and neighborhood connection to MacArthur Park throughout September 2026. 🌙🎶⚽

The community-centered event series created a welcoming space where families, neighbors, City departments, local organizations, and service providers could come together for food, entertainment, recreation, youth activities, and access to valuable resources.

At MacArthur Park, residents took part in activities including soccer and breakdancing, while community partners provided food distribution, public health resources, and other services.

Fall Friday Nights supports the City’s broader community safety efforts by creating positive opportunities for residents to gather, build connections, strengthen relationships, and enjoy MacArthur Park together.

Stay tuned for more upcoming events at MacArthur Park!
